cd /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_2/projects/recursive_gen_depth_est/docs/paper && echo "Entry count: $(grep -c '^@' references.bib)" && echo "Opening braces: $(grep -c '{' references.bib)" && echo "Lines: $(wc -l < references.bib)" && python3 -c "
with open('references.bib') as f:
    text = f.read()
entries = text.strip().split('\n\n')
for i, e in enumerate(entries):
    depth = 0
    for c in e:
        if c == '{': depth += 1
        elif c == '}': depth -= 1
    if depth != 0:
        lines = e.split('\n')
        print(f'UNBALANCED entry {i+1}: {lines[0]} (depth={depth})')
print(f'All {len(entries)} entries checked for balanced braces.')
"
